name: InDEx Collaboration
notes: Names of the member institutions are taken from the author affiliations on arXiv:2501.02833; the Atlas records no memberships.

summary.plain: The Indian team (Saha Institute of Nuclear Physics, Variable Energy Cyclotron Centre, BARC and partners) that runs the InDEx droplet dark matter search at the Jaduguda underground laboratory.
summary.technical: Authors of the InDEx papers: Saha Institute of Nuclear Physics, Variable Energy Cyclotron Centre (Kolkata), Homi Bhabha National Institute and the Health Physics Unit of BARC at Jaduguda. No formation date or member count is published in the sources read.
